title: Many-body physics and machine learning enabled discovery of promising solar materials
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,8253-8261
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA01285F, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Tathagata Biswas, Adway Gupta, Arunima K. Singh
Starting from a diverse dataset of 350+ GW-BSE computed quasiparticle gaps and exciton binding energies, a machine learning model is trained and then used to screen through 7K+ materials to identify 396 with excellent solar applications.
